title: Roveia dark steps card
description: A dark inset card with 40px corners over a background video under a 75% veil: a big light 64px heading on the left and three numbered steps on the right, each a white dot with 'Step n', a 40px light title and a quiet note. Phones stack heading and steps.
notes: one background media slot; empty, a light surface under the dark veil reads as the original's grey
